comment: Package 21: what the daily account `ares` (in wheel, owner 2026-11-09) may do through polkit. polkit-check.js evaluates the built image's real rules against this, for local active, local inactive and remote sessions, with and without wheel, following org.freedesktop.policykit.imply as polkitd does.
